column1: // TM-VCAP-CAL-003 Rev A  Variable Capacitor Voltage and Current Ratings
//   For a capacitor in a series or parallel resonant circuit:
//   I_peak   = √(2 × P_watts / R_load)   [for resistive load R_load]
//   P_loss   = I_peak² × R_ESR / 2       [average power dissipation in ESR]
//   In an antenna tuner with mismatch ratio M (M=SWR at tuner input):
//   Tank circuit voltage multiplication: V_C = Q_tank × V_source_pk
//   Typical Q_tank = 10-20 for pi/L networks at HF
// HIGH VOLTAGE WARNING: At 100W with Q=10 tank
//   At 500W with Q=15 tank at 14 MHz with C=50pF:
//   I_peak = √(2×500/50) × 15 = 141A (!)  — this is why thick plates matter
// Power handling in DIRECT connection (no tank Q multiplication):
//   VC in series with antenna: V_C = I × X_C
//   VC in shunt across 50Ω feed: V_C = V_feed = √(2 × P × 50)
// The DANGEROUS case is the tank/tuner network with high-Q and mismatch
